clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, The Defias Brotherhood is building a network beyond banditry. Wiley the Black sends word of its ties to gnolls, kobolds, and goblins. Gryan Stoutmantle needs this intelligence to measure the full reach of the conspiracy choking Westfall.

Wiley the Black says telling what he knows about the Defias could cost him his life. Along the edges of Redridge and Westfall, he has caught wind of an operation far greater than highway robbery. His sealed note describes how the Brotherhood has coordinated groups that are usually hostile to one another across the countryside.

Wiley warns that the Defias has drawn an alarming network around itself. The red-masked outlaws have enlisted gnoll packs, kobold diggers, and goblin engineers instead of working alone. Together, their brutal muscle, burrowing labor, and mechanical cunning point to an enterprise beyond what the People's Militia first expected.

Gryan Stoutmantle has little love for Wiley and openly laments that he did not leave the rogue to rot when he had the chance. Yet Westfall cannot afford pride. With Stormwind ignoring pleas for military aid, the People's Militia must take useful intelligence wherever it can find it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What I am about to tell you could cost me my life. The Defias gang is up to something big. Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.
Take this note to Stoutmantle. It explains as much as I know on the subject.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Good to see you back, friend. What did Wiley have to say for himself?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Bah! I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance. But this information is crucial. Good work.
